title: Janus Cristal × recovered FractalGPT — Dual-Null Specificity Gate
question: After adding a uniform random planner, a Fourier phase-scramble null, and non-quartz crystal controls, does any semantic or mirror-symmetry candidate remain specific to the petroleum-quartz visible/UV pair?

method.semantic_gate: token length >=3; >=2 hits within a planner; word/formula/code-like; absent from block control; then >=2 independent planner families for cross-planner escalation
method.mirror_gate: real minus block-control mirror correlation > 0 AND real minus phase-control mirror correlation > 0

recovered_model_training.interpretation: The recovered micro-model executed deterministically and changed under training; model loss is not itself evidence about crystals.

mirror_dual_null_specificity.reason: The target visible image loses the prior 5/5 sign under the phase null and uniform baseline, while non-quartz calcite and optical fluorite show equal or stronger dual-null planner counts.

mirror_candidate_history.epistemic_value: A prior positive-looking image effect was successfully falsified rather than promoted.

source_provenance_additions.published_description: 8x8x8 mm optical fluorite crystal with Newton rings

next_gate.name: FRACTALGPT_SAME_SPECIMEN_SPECTRAL_DIFFERENCE_MAPPING
requirements: register visible and UV405 images of the same specimen into one coordinate frame before region comparison
construct a preregistered visible-vs-UV difference map without OCR or semantic labels
use FractalGPT planners and uniform random sampling only to sample that difference field, not to define the field after seeing outcomes
compare fluorescence/inclusion contrast against spatially matched null regions
replicate on additional visible/UV pairs when open data are available
keep neon, sunlight and quartz-on-quartz as physical-test pending unless direct matched recordings are obtained

claim_ceiling: v0.3 finds no admissible hidden message, formula, code or algorithm. It also rejects the earlier mirror-symmetry candidate as non-specific after stronger null models and non-quartz controls. The next scientifically useful target is registered same-specimen spectral/material contrast, not symbolic decoding.
